changes_vs_previous: NVIDIA Q2 revenue 96.2bn USD and Data Center 89bn USD plus strong forward growth guidance materially pushed back the AI-capex-peak thesis; the preferred expression shifts from indiscriminate quality-vs-capex short to defined-risk quality/semiconductor upside after price discovery.
China style leadership reversed sharply: CSI1000 +2.50% and IM2609 +2.60% versus SSE50 +0.87% and IH2609 +0.87%, with broad market breadth and higher turnover supporting the move.
IM cash basis narrowed from about -0.701% on 2026-08-26 to about -0.599% on 2026-08-27 while IH basis stayed near -0.56%, strengthening the small-cap risk-appetite signal.
China industrial profits Jan-Jul rose 17.6%, July rose 11.2%, and computer/communications/electronics profits were exceptionally strong, providing a fundamental tailwind to technology leadership.

EIA US distillate inventories fell 2.2m barrels and remained around 14% below the five-year seasonal average, but Singapore middle-distillate inventories rose to a two-week high; refined-product scarcity remains a conditional trade, no longer the top-ranked opportunity.

Gold held structurally high levels despite 10Y real yield around 2.34%, but the post-PCE 1.4% decline showed traditional real-rate sensitivity remains active; Warsh is the next key policy-credit test.

trade_cards.name: NVIDIA后质量AI/半导体多头
trade_cards.structure: NVDA or SOXX 30-60D buy 30-40Delta call / sell 10-20Delta call; QQQ 45-75D if broader expression preferred
trade_cards.entry: Wait at least 30 minutes after US cash open; enter on the first 1-2% pullback only if NVDA holds opening-range support and SOXX/QQQ relative strength remains positive. Do not chase if NVDA exceeds roughly +9% versus pre-earnings close without a pullback.
trade_cards.scaling: Starter max loss 0.35-0.50% NAV; add only if first-hour high is reclaimed without a simultaneous 8-10bp long-yield surge; confirmed total max loss 0.75-1.00% NAV.
trade_cards.invalidation: NVDA closes back below pre-earnings close; or post-call interpretation turns into peak data-center/margin expectations; or SOXX materially underperforms on a rate shock.

trade_cards.greeks: +Delta +Gamma +Vega -Theta near long strike; vertical chosen because single-name event IV is expected to crush

trade_cards.margin_note: Product/broker margin can exceed exchange minimum; a roughly 12% same-day secondary reference implies about CNY1.47m gross margin for the example before any spread offsets. Must use actual member/broker margin at execution.
trade_cards.entry: On next trading day 09:30-10:15 BJT, require IM to outperform IH by at least another 0.35pct, breadth/technology turnover to stay supportive, and preferably fresh OI showing IM is not merely rising on a large OI collapse. At least two of three conditions required.
